start.title: [TODO:tr] Two Households
start.text:
[TODO:tr] Your flocks and Lot's fill the same valley.
The land groans under so much life.

tension.title: [TODO:tr] Crowded Wells
tension.text:
[TODO:tr] Two flocks. One well. The shepherds' voices rise.
Something must give.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Claim the well by right of age

quarrel.title: [TODO:tr] The Herdsmen Clash
quarrel.text:
[TODO:tr] Staffs raised. Shouts in the dust.
A blow could break everything between you.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Order your men to strike first

decision.title: [TODO:tr] Speaking to Lot
decision.text:
[TODO:tr] You take Lot aside. "We are family.
Let there be no strife between us."

offering.title: [TODO:tr] The Open Hand
offering.text:
[TODO:tr] "If you go left, I go right.
If you go right, I go left. Choose."

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Hope quietly he picks the lesser
[TODO:tr] Mean every word — release the land

lots_choice.title: [TODO:tr] Lot Looks East
lots_choice.text:
[TODO:tr] Lot sees the Jordan plain — green, watered, rich.
He chooses it without hesitation.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Resent him for taking the best
[TODO:tr] Bless him and let him go

lot_departs.title: [TODO:tr] The Parting
lot_departs.text:
[TODO:tr] Lot's flocks move toward the plain.
The dust of his road settles slowly.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Stand and watch him without bitterness

remaining.title: [TODO:tr] What Is Left
remaining.text:
[TODO:tr] The hills are dry, the valley quiet.
You are alone with the land God gave.

choices.text: [TODO:tr] Count what you lost in flocks

the_promise.title: [TODO:tr] Lift Your Eyes
the_promise.text:
[TODO:tr] "All the land you see — I give to you.
Your offspring will be as the dust."
